# Renewal Applicant

##### Important Renewal Information:

In the State of Ohio a Renewal application is required every five years.  You can renew at any time.  There are no penalties for applying after your permit has expired.

Prior to June 13th, 2022 do not carry concealed after your 30 day grace period.  Effective June 13th, 2022 you will no longer be required to have your CCW Permit on your person, while you are carrying concealed, in the state of Ohio. [See this Constitutional Carry Act Summary](https://www.legislature.ohio.gov/download?key=18493&format=pdf).

##### To Apply:

- Have the following documents required for upload:

- Current Permit
- Valid State Issued ID (e.g. Driver’s License)
- Bring a valid state issued ID to your appointment
- [Apply here](https://hamiltonsooh.permitium.com/ccw/application?permittype=renewal)
